closingNote: Closed slow — we led objectives but the game ran 38 minutes. Convert Fangtooth/tower leads into ending the game, don't farm the lead and risk a throw.

coaching.headline: The map was buried — 33 objective takes to 11 and 109,297 objective damage to 21,605 — and it still took 38 minutes because eight won fights cashed only twice.
coaching.team: The engine worked: a deathless 8/0 Iggy & Scorch in mid, Boris grinding 51739 into objectives, and every big prize from minute 24 on — three Primal Fangtooths, both Orb Primes, two Genesis Cores. The two leaks were the familiar ones: the 13 and 18-minute Fangtooths were both lost as cross-map trades while we won the bodies (10.8, 12.6 and 16.7 all carry the 'they traded it' note), and the offlane was flagged alive-and-absent at 4.9, 13.6, 18.4 and 33.8. Riktor and Crunch caught three of us alone; the closing note says the rest — convert the lead, don't farm it.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 3-0 at our Primal Fangtooth at 24 opened the floodgates — Primal, Genesis Core and Orb Prime fell in a three-minute window — and the 31.1 4-1 on top of our Orb pit put the game permanently out of reach.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31's Boris was the objective engine — a team-high 51739 objective damage with 17 assists and five kills on Crunch — despite a jungle read that said 'theirs all game'. The two solo catches at 9.1 and 23 are the tax of pathing through Crunch's side without vision backup.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Grux won his numbers — 4/3/9 with 31992 hero damage and 16 wards — but the film flags him absent from fights at 4.9, 13.6, 18.4 and 33.8, and both enemy Fangtooths (13 and 18) were lifted cross-map while we won the 12.6 and 16.7 fights short a body. Grux's pull-knockup chain is an engage the team fought those fights without.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim played the most aggressive support line on file — 12 kills on Zinx with first blood at 2.3, 20 wards, and 13014 healing. Eight deaths is the price of that style, and his 13-minute fall is the one the file prices at a Fangtooth; everything else, the trade was worth it.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.8s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Zinx) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down

ourKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
ourKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
World Breaker (item): On dealing Magical Damage to a Hero: Increases your Magical Damage dealt by 2% for 4.5s. Stacks up to 6 times.

lead.text: 1,799 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Iggy & Scorch mid players this patch (34% of the team's), while mitigating less than 75% of them. The damage came from Megacosm, Tainted Scepter, Entropy. Died 0 times.
lead.lesson: Iggy & Scorch built for damage with little to soak it: focus Iggy & Scorch first in fights and the damage leaves with them (a plan, not something the data shows happened).

stacks.title: Every ability hit set off

members.name: Megacosm
members.text: On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.

members.name: Entropy
members.text: On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Entropy. Iggy & Scorch has 4 damaging abilities (Molotov, Oil Spill, Inferno hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 58 ability haste brought them back 37% sooner: more casts, more triggers.

copy.text: this 3-item core: 57.9% in 95 games, above the 54% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.

loadout.name: Turret Maniac
loadout.text: Increase your Maximum Number of Turrets to 4, but they have 20% less Health.
loadout.plain: You can have 4 turrets out, but each is easier to kill. Spread them around a fight or objective to zone the area.

loadout.name: Epoch
loadout.plain: Your panic button. When divers jump you, freeze yourself to wait out their burst while your turrets keep shooting.
